text:
Asha Patel: Hey team — ACME approaching 12/1 renewal. They want the SOW attached to the invoice and a single PO that covers both hosted and On-Prem seats. Any blockers?
Dan Liu: thanks for the heads up. Sales gave them a 10% seat discount for Yr2 because of volume. need to confirm if legal needs the discount written into the SOW or if invoice annotation is fine.
Julie Kim: legal prefers the commercial terms in the SOW + an amendment referencing the PO. invoice note alone isn't sufficient for audit.
Rory Chen: from onboarding side, we need enablement scheduled immediately after e-sign. if they push signatures late it delays migration window.
Asha Patel: @Julie can we do a short amendment that says: "10% discount applied to seats for term 12/1–11/30" and include the PO number in the amendment?
Julie Kim: yes that's acceptable. I'll draft a one-paragraph amendment. will loop in procurement wording for PO inclusion.
Dan Liu: procurement says they'll issue PO once accounting sees invoice + SOW alignment. can we attach a draft invoice to speed it?
Sam Ortega: Finance here — attach proforma with line items and VAT handling. ACME is EU-based, send net of VAT with VAT reverse-charge note. use code: EU-RC on invoice.
Asha Patel: copy. I'll upload draft SOW + proforma in the thread. @ProcureBot can you monitor for the incoming PO?
ProcureBot: Automated: PO request ticket #67890 created. Status: waiting_for_vendor_docs. ETA for PO issuance: 3 business days after docs received. :gear:
Dan Liu: to be safe, can we set the effective term start to 12/5 in the amendment to allow a buffer for signatures/PO? customer is ok with that shift.
Julie Kim: yes — amend term start to 12/5 and add clause: "Services will commence upon receipt of fully executed amendment or PO, whichever occurs later." keeps both parties covered.
Rory Chen: scheduling note — I'll tentatively hold enablement slots 12/6 and 12/7. if PO/exec completes earlier I'll free one.
Asha Patel: uploaded: `ACME_SOW_v3_draft.pdf` and `proforma_ACME_yr2.xlsx`. Link: https://files.redwood/acme/ACME_SOW_v3_draft.pdf
Sam Ortega: quick check on amounts — proforma shows 480 seats at $0.18/token unit and $1,200/mo infra. can we add a small line for migration credit? customer negotiated a $15k one-time migration credit.
Dan Liu: yes include a negative line item: Migration Credit: -$15,000. final net due for Yr2 in proforma should reflect that.
Julie Kim: draft amendment attached to the SOW. minor redlines: add PO number placeholder and the effective-date language. i'll send as tracked changes.
ProcureBot: Automated: Vendor docs received (ACME_SOW_v3_draft.pdf). Advancing ticket #67890 to status: under_review.
Asha Patel: great — once PO comes in I will route to legal for signature and then to AE for countersign. timeline looks achievable for 12/5 start.
Sam Ortega: FYI — Finance needs billing contact and remit address on the PO. @Dan please confirm with procurement contact.
Dan Liu: pinged ACME procurement lead (cc'd). they said will include remit: ACME Payments Ltd, IBAN ****. expect PO by end of week.
Rory Chen: noted on enablement. I'll keep slots warm and prepare transfer checklist.
Asha Patel: thanks team. next actions: Julie finalize amendment, Sam confirm proforma numbers with migration credit, Dan push for PO, ProcureBot watch ticket. will reconvene here on PO arrival. :thumbsup:
